title: Cone 6 Soda Fire
summary: Fire 7-8 mug-size pots in Sara Patterson's Cone 6 soda kiln in Bethel, NY on October 24, 2026. Waterbrook coordinates drop-off, glazing, wadding and loading. Choose to use Sara's glazes ($50) or bring your own ($40).
evidence_sentence: Sara Patterson's soda kiln fires at Cone 6; Waterbrook members drop off, glaze, wad and load pots on October 24.
